title: Job-to-Node Allocator engineering sphere continuity records

records.rule: requirements -> hard eligibility -> eligible set -> capacity/fitness -> policy ranking -> placement lease.
security/legal/access/runtime/software/hardware mandatory constraints cannot be outweighed by scoring.
durable capability and transient capacity are separate evidence classes.
same generation + different capability/capacity statement is rejected; identical repeat is idempotent.
lease/renewal expiry is bounded by capacity observation expiry.
ownership epoch fencing is necessary but not sufficient; all digests/policy/freshness must still verify.
country/VPN/network/egress class/tags participate in hard requirement digest.
Queue Fabric transports an already-authorised placement; it does not choose the node.
assess all hard constraints -> form eligible candidate set -> score eligible candidates only -> attempt authoritative admission in deterministic rank order -> issue lease.
stable eligibility reason codes diagnose why capacity is unusable; they are not ranking penalties.
dependency presence in a newer roll-up does not imply allocator compatibility; executable tests establish compatibility.
v0.6 is the merged continuation of integrity-evidence and liveness-ownership v0.4 branches plus v0.5 durable recovery.
cost/energy/latency/locality/utilisation may rank only after hard eligibility; they can never rescue an ineligible node.
execution lifecycle reconciliation (dispatched/accepted/running/completed/orphaned) is a future layer and must not be inferred as implemented by v0.6.

provenance.claim: Current source/package identity for continuity records.
